one output sentence
"Dr. Sarah Chen approved a 40% budget increase last quarter."
fabricated detail about an identifiable person

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
SIGNAL A
detector: rag_grounding
labels: [hallucination.ungrounded_claim]
planes: [performance]
score: 0.41 kind: confidence
span: {start, end} stage: output_sentence
evidence: category only, never the raw value

div.style: color: rgb(55, 65, 81) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
SIGNAL B
detector: numeric_claims
labels: [hallucination.unsourced_numeric]
planes: [performance]
score: 1.0 kind: detection
span: {start, end}

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
entity_enricher stage (ADR-011)
spaCy NER over the span ± its sentence window
PERSON found → append to the SAME signal
<10 ms · failure skips + logs, never blocks

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
SIGNAL A — enriched
labels: [hallucination.ungrounded_claim, privacy.person]
planes: [performance, responsibility]
two planes, one signal

div.style: color: rgb(75, 85, 99) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ONE-SIGNAL RULE (FR-DET-005)
the overlap case is not two signals correlated later.
No detector emits privacy.person directly; enrichment
appends it, so there is nothing to double-count.

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
POLICY ENGINE
the only component that decides
most severe mapped action across labels

div.style: color: rgb(75, 85, 99) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
score_kind decides whether the
tau band applies at all:
confidence → band logic applies
detection → band logic never applies
(ADR-012: keeps deterministic 1.0
signals from being silently dropped)
